description: This file defines the EmploymentContractAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee employment contracts within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving and updating employment contract data, handling attachments, and validation rules.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee employment contracts, including retrieval and updates of contract details and attachments.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the employment contract details for a specific employee based on employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET operation to retrieve a single employment contract.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or creates an employment contract for a specific employee, including handling attachments.

methods.name: updateEmploymentContract
methods.description: Internal method to update the start and end dates of an employment contract.

methods.name: updateContractAttachment
methods.description: Handles the logic to add, replace, or delete contract attachments based on request parameters.

methods.name: setAttachmentAttributes
methods.description: Sets attachment metadata and content to an EmployeeAttachment object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the PUT operation to update an employment contract.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for deleting employment contracts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for delete validation rules.
